title: The Night Before Christmas

vibeProfile.oneLine: A lovesick blacksmith catches the Devil to win a pair of slippers.

summary: On Christmas Eve in a Ukrainian village, a lovesick blacksmith strikes a bargain, catches the Devil himself, and flies to St Petersburg to win the slippers that will win his sweetheart. Gogol's exuberant folk-tale, from his early Evenings on a Farm Near Dikanka, mixes Christmas magic, comedy and the supernatural with his unmistakable relish for the absurd. Short, warm and wildly inventive, it is a festive read quite unlike the usual carols and snow.
whyReadIt: A wild, funny Christmas folk-tale with the Devil in it. Gogol's festive magic, unlike any other Christmas story.

funFacts.text: It comes from Gogol's early Ukrainian folk-tale collection, Evenings on a Farm Near Dikanka.
